description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipService class, which provides methods for managing employee membership data, including saving, retrieving by ID, searching, counting, and deleting memberships within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipService
classes.description: Service class for handling employee membership operations such as save, retrieve, search, count, and delete.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EmployeeMembershipDao instance.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeMembership entity using the DAO.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeMembership by employee number and ID.

methods.name: searchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Searches for employee memberships based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of employee memberships matching filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeMemberships
methods.description: Deletes specified employee memberships by IDs.
